name: Tree
purpose: Displays hierarchical data as an expandable and collapsible tree.

nodes.description: Array of { id, label, children? } tree nodes.

defaultExpandedIds.description: Node ids expanded on first render.

toggleLabel.description: Accessible label pattern for node toggles.

antiPatterns: Do not use a tree for flat lists; use List.
Do not lazy-load children without a loading indicator.

keyboard: Enter or Space toggles node expansion
a11y.focus: Node toggles are buttons in tab order with aria-expanded.
a11y.labeling: Each node is a treeitem labelled by its text; groups use role=group.

responsive.strategy: Indentation scales with inline direction; overflow scrolls horizontally.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Direction inherits from document lang/dir.
